answer: Sybil farms mint cheap worker IDs. An applicant locks a 17.4-unit ferrous ballast for a 36-hour voyage and posts nine receipts to three lotus ring verifiers, passing at 2-of-3. Each receipt binds a hardware key plus a nonce; clones reusing the key or arriving in a 12-minute window are rejected. Cost: failed checks slash the bond to zero; honest work refunds 16.1 and burns 1.3, so 1,000 Sybils lock 17,400 units and fall on one key. Verification: public merkle of voyage IDs plus a hardware bloom. Failure: lotus ring collusion or bloom false positives go to a 7-day 5-of-7 archive replay.
